Lina (product): Brainstorm: 'soft-reserve pulse' — customers buy small reserved pools + a time-boxed pulse window where extra requests are admitted with soft guarantees (best-effort, preemptible). Need launch checklist and acceptance criteria.
Ben (eng): Sounds promising. Key: deterministic admission order and preempt logic. Soft pulses should never evict reserved lane. Provide per-tenant pulse-rate cap.
Hiro (eng-runtime): Implementation: route order reserved -> pulse -> shared. Tag pulse requests with pulse_id and decrement a pulse_balance atomically. Use short-lived tokens for idempotency.
Maya (eng-sre): Observability: pulse_admit_rate, pulse_preempt_rate, pulse_latency_p95, regional_spill. Runbook: disable pulse if GPU util >75% for 10m or pulse_preempt_rate >5% for 5m.
Ethan (sales): Customers want a simple SKU: monthly pulse bucket + UI showing remaining pulse minutes. Pricing around 50% of on-demand looks attractive.
Priya (cs): Pilot asks: pulse_success >=80% on 2x burst, pulse P95 <600ms, clear invoice lines and CSV export for disputes.
Lina (product): Launch criteria draft: 1) API flags + per-tenant cap, 2) preemption semantics documented, 3) dashboards + alerts, 4) billing line-item, 5) two pilots.
Ben (eng): Rough effort: runtime changes 3 sprint-weeks, KV + idempotency 1 sprint-week, billing/UI 1-2 weeks, obs + test harness 1-2 weeks.
Hiro (eng-runtime): Add canary gating: enable per-region after 48h with <1% P95 regression.
ci-bot: feature-flag created: ff/soft-reserve-pulse -> off.
Lina (product): I'll write RFC with ops playbook and pilot pack. Assigning owners now.
